integrity: The infinite claim is proved by multiplicativity, the exact prime-power formula, parity, size bounds, and an exhaustive algebraic split of the two- and three-prime squarefree cases. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem excludes all non-squarefree composites and all squarefree composites with at most three distinct prime factors from \(n\mid P(n)+1\). It does not exclude squarefree solutions with four or more distinct prime factors and does not claim that the four-prime lower bound is sharp.
title: A four-prime barrier for the Pillai gcd-sum plus-one congruence
